description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rawatawatta, Morotuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520201
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details, and encumbrances) in various villages and divisions. The content focuses entirely on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
